scenes.text: Your team rents a giant AI model by the token — to do the same small job, over and over.
scenes.say: Your team rents a giant A.I. model by the token, to do the same small job over and over.

scenes.text: Your CFO wants the bill down. Your engineers want proof it won't break.
scenes.say: Your C.F.O. wants the bill down. Your engineers want proof it won't break.

scenes.text: FallForge Mint starts with one question: which model is enough? The sizer suggests the smallest open-weight model that should clear your bar. A one-billion answer says one billion.
scenes.say: Fall Forge Mint starts with one question. Which model is enough? The sizer suggests the smallest open-weight model that should clear your bar. A one billion answer says one billion.

scenes.text: Mint it from a few of your own examples. Then it tries to beat the base model on examples kept out of its spec — and it can say you lost.
scenes.say: Mint it from a few of your own examples. Then it tries to beat the base model on examples kept out of its spec, and it can say you lost.

scenes.text: You get a signed scorecard. The held-out answers weren't in the spec we gave the model. Anyone can re-run it.

scenes.text: At high use, owning can run six to seventeen times cheaper. When renting wins, it says keep renting.
scenes.say: At high use, owning can run six to seventeen times cheaper. When renting wins, it says keep renting.

scenes.text: One file. Your machine. No meter.

scenes.text: And Forge is one door into a whole sovereign estate. Seven stages, one pipeline.
scenes.say: And Forge is one door into a whole sovereign estate. Seven stages, one pipeline.

scenes.text: Gated builds ride a trust rail: it breaks the code to test the tests. It even found a line left-pad's passing tests don't check.

scenes.text: In fall-os, you hatch your own assistant and level it into your own operating system.

scenes.text: The dispatcher routes every job: seven organs run themselves, nine wait for a human key, and eight are honestly marked to-do.

scenes.text: Peers connect directly, no server between — and sovereign-foundry ties it together.

scenes.text: Models trained on their own output lose the tails. A mesh of real people is the clean signal. Owned, provable AI is the moat.
